levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Two or more tools sorted into the wrong category.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least five of six tools sorted correctly.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All six sorted correctly and the learner self-corrects an initial miscategorization.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reasons are vague, for example 'it's dangerous.'

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Reasons name a specific hazard type for most tools.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reasons name a specific hazard type for every tool and distinguish 'needs supervision' from 'adult-only' clearly.

lookFors: Adult confirms each tool's category before moving on.
Reference list uses the learner's own words, not copied definitions.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
